description: This file handles user data management for a CRM system, including user creation, editing, deletion of images, password changes, duplication checks, and email notifications. It interacts with the database, manages session and permission checks, and includes various auxiliary files.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: Represents user data and methods for user management within the CRM system.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates the user record in the database.

methods.name: change_password
methods.description: Changes the user's password after verifying the old password.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves user information based on record ID.
